products.name: Modular Lounge Sofa
products.short: A modular corner sofa in soft neutral tones – perfect for meeting lounges and executive suites. Arrange it to fit your space.

products.name: Walnut Lounge Chair

products.name: Round Lounge Chair

products.name: Mesh Reception Desk

products.name: Illuminated Reception Desk

products.name: Curved Reception Desk

products.name: Workstation with Planter

products.name: Executive Desk – Cream

products.name: TV Wall Unit with LED Shelves

products.name: Round Coffee Table

products.name: Tall Grey Storage Cabinets

products.name: Curved Lobby Sofa
products.short: A long, curving cream sofa on a glossy red wood base with matching end tables. Made to measure for large lobbies and waiting areas.

products.name: Beige Corner Sofa

products.name: Grey Armchair

products.name: Y-Shaped Lobby Seating

products.name: Wave Atrium Seating

products.name: Round Meeting Pod

products.name: Orange Corner Sofa

products.name: Oval Meeting Table

products.name: Oak 3-Door Wardrobe

products.name: Upholstered Bed

products.name: Buttoned Leather Armchair
products.short: A classic armchair with a button-tufted back in soft taupe leather and dark wooden legs, shown in a lounge setting.

products.name: Curved Corner Sofa
products.short: A soft light grey corner sofa with rounded arms and piped edges, shown with a round black coffee table.

products.name: Leather Lounge Armchairs

products.name: Waiting Area Benches

products.name: Hexagon Workstation

products.name: Marble Coffee Table
